mcp:tool-listener.name: find_orders
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: List a customer's orders from the email address they ordered with. Returns each order number, order date, status, items and delivery status. Use it when the customer hasn't given an order number.

mcp:tool-listener.name: get_order
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Get one order in full: every item, the workshop production of made-to-order items (supplier order, stages done and left, promised and estimated ready dates, delay and its reason) and the delivery booking. The email must be the one on the order, otherwise the order is reported as not found.

mcp:tool-listener.name: list_delivery_slots
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: List the free delivery slots for an order whose delivery is booked and more than 48 hours away. Call it before rescheduling, and offer the customer only these slots.

mcp:tool-listener.name: reschedule_delivery
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Move a booked delivery to one of the free slots from list_delivery_slots. Only call it once the customer has chosen that exact slot.

mcp:tool-listener.name: open_care_case
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Open a case for the customer-care team: damage on delivery, a delay the customer wants followed up, a delivery that can't be moved online, or anything the other tools can't solve. Returns a case number the customer can quote.
